about_the_game:
The development team Autremelon presents you with the first challenge!

In the Burning House, rogue-like unite with your stress, the tasks of space exploration, resource allocation, and house-destroying fire to catch you off guard!

Seek in the darkness

The darkness has hidden the "keys" and "doors" from you—find at least a match and seize a piece of fire’s essence to make out the path.

Look around

The house is falling apart, but find the silver lining—find a way to turn the collapsing floor, falling beams, and fragile walls to your advantage. Discover useful items in the dark basement or shorten your path. Break what’s still standing if it helps you!

Beware of the guests

There are guests in the house—they have come for you and are wandering around the house.

Use their weaknesses in the chase, distract them and hide, or face the creatures in a fight!

Watch yourself

Your stamina will run out, you will be overcome by pain, weakness and injuries—this will simplify the hunt for the guests and reduce your chances of making it in time.

Know Your House

The house reconfigures every time — forget the past, explore the present.

Escape the inevitable

...just do it.

content_descriptors.notes:
- Vague pixel images of skinless creatures with visible, protruding bones. 
- There is a "self-harm" action, situationally beneficial to use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: win 7-11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3450
  • Memory: 3072 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 640

short_description: This is a game about escape: escape from the inevitable that has caught up with you in a trap of wood and fire! Explore a house that randomly reconfigures itself every time, and with cold calculation, use everything you find in the rooms—but beware of the guests... or drive them out of this world!
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Persian
